title: 第3章 小师弟吃鱼不第4章 周师兄你是不是喜欢银发啊
slug: 掌门师伯新收了个女徒弟
content_zh:
随之，大殿内便传来掌教客气的寒暄声，对各位师弟能百忙之中前来参加小六的拜师而感谢，尤其是各种礼物。
众峰主则笑着“哪里哪里”、“都是一家人”、“见过那孩子了”……
周清则一阵美滋滋，因为他又听到了提示音。
其实他很想藏起来，但“藏”和“被无视”，可是两个不同的概念。
一会过后，从侧门那边，首席大师兄李道玄带着鹿瑶瑶便进来了。
鹿瑶瑶开始重新见过诸位峰主，下方的许多男性核心弟子一个个踮着脚跟，看着上方的那道靓影，喜笑颜开。
真是漂亮的小师妹。
犹记得多年前云梦峰峰主收了一个女徒时，也是像今天这般热闹，不过核心弟子可没如今这么多。
因为那位师姐相貌一般，甚至还有点猪拱鼻，甚至有人当场低声彼此打趣“你老婆你老婆……”
可如今，看着这位恬静中又带着点古灵精怪的小师妹时，众人一个个嘴都快笑到耳后根了。
“嗯？”
就在周清刚刷了三个“忽略点”时，突然察觉周围师兄弟们一个个不断四顾，似乎在找什么人一样。
他有些疑惑的看去，这才注意到台阶上方站在掌教一旁的鹿瑶瑶，不断在人群中扫视着什么。
当她看到角落一侧的周清时，立马眼睛一亮。
此时周清顿时心生不好感。
大妹子，我就算再怎么天纵神武，你也不至于当着这么多人的面，给我公然拉仇恨吧？
而且你这都注意到了我，忽略点还怎么刷？
存在感又怎么降低？
很快，顺着鹿瑶瑶的目光，大家齐刷刷看向周清，满脸的疑惑。
而周清见此，一副没看见的样子，身子不经意往前挪了挪，站在了殿内一根硕大的白玉柱后。

并开始装模作样的用手抚摸玉柱，似乎在观察着什么。
而看不到周清的身影，鹿瑶瑶身子又往旁边侧了侧，勉强只能看到一点衣角，但很快，那点衣角也被一只手抓了回去。
她撇撇嘴，只好站直身子。
众人有些疑惑，这位漂亮的小师妹认识周清？
不应该啊，难不成是昨晚的无耻行为，让这位小师妹想见识一下，这偷窥狂魔到底是何种样貌？
得，一颗老鼠屎坏了一锅汤，这让小师妹以后怎么看待我们这群核心弟子。
面对众人一副恨铁不成钢的眼神，周清继续用手抚摸着白玉柱。
一副看不见，听不见的无所谓样子。
三师兄说的对，红颜祸水，这女的以后得防着才是。
“咦~~”
就在这时，周清突然发现，眼前的白玉柱子里，似乎有什么东西在动。
眼花了吗？
他揉了揉眼，又仔细看去。
下一刻，一只如同米粒大小的白色虫子，突然在里面一闪而逝。
这下，周清看的仔仔细细的，心里更是一阵狂跳。
如果没看错的话，刚才那只虫子应该是极为稀有的灵隐虫。
灵隐虫啊，这家伙对生存环境可是极为苛刻，只存在于特定的矿物中。
而且它吸食的可都是最为纯净的能量，一旦炼化，近乎会原封不动的反哺给修炼者，助其突破修为。
周清强忍激动，没想到误打误撞下竟然还能碰到这样的好东西。
content_en:
Then, the headmaster's polite greetings came from the hall, thanking all the juniors for taking the time out of their busy schedules to attend Xiaoliu's apprenticeship, especially for the various gifts.
The peak leaders smiled and said, "No matter where you are", "We are all a family", "I have seen that child"...
Zhou Qing was delighted because he heard the notification sound again.
In fact, he wanted to hide, but "hiding" and "being ignored" were two different concepts.
After a while, from the side door, Chief Senior Brother Li Daoxuan came in with Lu Yaoyao.
Lu Yaoyao began to see the peak masters again. Many of the male core disciples below stood on tiptoes, looking at the beautiful figure above, smiling happily.
What a beautiful little junior sister.
I still remember that when the master of Yunmeng Peak accepted a female disciple many years ago, it was as lively as it is today, but there were not as many core disciples as there are now.
Because the senior sister had an average appearance and even had a pig nose, some people even joked to each other in a low voice on the spot, "Your wife, your wife..."
But now, when looking at this little junior sister who is quiet and a little quirky, everyone is laughing almost to the ears.
"Huh?"
Just when Zhou Qing had cleared three "ignored points", he suddenly noticed that the fellow disciples around him were constantly looking around, as if they were looking for someone.
He looked with some doubts, and then noticed Lu Yaoyao standing next to the headmaster at the top of the steps, constantly scanning the crowd for something.
When she saw Zhou Qing on the side of the corner, her eyes immediately lit up.
At this time, Zhou Qing suddenly felt bad.
Big sister, no matter how powerful I am, you won’t openly bring hatred to me in front of so many people, right?
And you have noticed me, so how can you brush me if you ignore it?
How can the sense of presence be reduced?
Soon, following Lu Yaoyao's gaze, everyone looked at Zhou Qing with doubts on their faces.
When Zhou Qing saw this, he acted as if he hadn't seen it. He moved forward inadvertently and stood behind a huge white jade pillar in the hall.
And began to pretend to touch the jade pillar with his hand, as if he was observing something.
As Zhou Qing could not be seen, Lu Yaoyao turned to the side again. She could barely see the corner of her clothes, but soon, the corner of her clothes was grabbed back by a hand.
She pouted and had to stand up straight.
Everyone was a little confused. Does this beautiful junior sister know Zhou Qing?
It shouldn't be. Could it be that last night's shameless behavior made this little junior sister want to see what this voyeur looks like?
Come on, a rat droppings ruins a pot of soup. This will make the junior sister think of our group of core disciples in the future.
Facing everyone's eyes, Zhou Qing continued to caress the white jade pillar with his hand.
He looked like he couldn't see or hear anything.
The third senior brother is right, beauty is a disaster, and you have to be careful about this woman in the future.
"Eh~~"
At this moment, Zhou Qing suddenly discovered that something seemed to be moving in the white jade pillar in front of him.
Dazzled?
He rubbed his eyes and looked carefully again.
The next moment, a white insect as big as a grain of rice suddenly flashed inside.
This time, Zhou Qing looked carefully, and his heart beat wildly.
If I read it correctly, the insect just now should be an extremely rare spiritual hidden insect.
Spiritual Hidden Insect, this guy is extremely harsh on the living environment and only exists in specific minerals.
Moreover, what it absorbs is the purest energy. Once refined, it will be fed back to the cultivator almost intact, helping him to achieve breakthroughs in cultivation.
Zhou Qing suppressed his excitement, but he didn't expect to encounter such a good thing by accident.
